violated_contract: A wire-flash firmware artifact must not replace a hardware-qualified bootloader with an unqualified default implementation, even when the application and its OTA package are valid.
canonical_prevention: Build the board-specific bootloader entrypoint explicitly and require its exact jig-qualified padded hash, key and layout. Construct wire images from that loader plus the exact tested OTA app bytes; exclude unrelated flash regions. Parse every staged HEX against the approved hash list at staging, promotion and publication.
